decision.explanation: The two documents (d00 and d01) both describe Rush Township in Scioto County, Ohio, but provide conflicting population figures (3,171 vs. 12,456) from the 2010 census. These are incompatible claims about the same entity and time period. Document d02 and d03 refer to Rush Township in Tuscarawas County, Ohio, which is a different entity and thus not relevant to the question.
